thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: High GPU queue growth detected for private cluster `acme-vpc-1` (customer tenant). Autoscaler triggered but observed failures.Severity=high :rotating_light:
ryan (oncall): +1 seeing alerts, paging in eng-runtime and SRE. Jumping in.
maya.nguyen: on it. pulling logs now, can anyone confirm impact to active customers?
tj (eng-runtime): metrics look bad: pending inference jobs climbing fast. early sign: provision attempts failing.
opsbot: Incident created: INC-204012 (autoscale-provision-failure). Paging ryan, maya, tj.
ryan (oncall): quick status from metrics:
```
Queue: pending=312 -> 1380 over 7m
Avg latency: 18s -> 95s
Autoscaler: scale_attempts=6, successes=3, failures=3
Failure reason (node-provision): ImagePull backoff / cloud quota errors
```
maya.nguyen: grabbing `kubectl describe` from cluster (private plane):
```
Events:
  0s   0s     0     pod/gpu-provision-xyz  Warning  FailedScheduling  3/6 nodes are unschedulable: 3 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
  0s   0s     0     node/provision-abc       Warning  FailedProvision     Provisioner cloud API returned 403: quota exceeded for external ips
  0s   0s     0     pod/gpu-pull-123         Warning  ImagePullBackOff   registry rate limit exceeded
```
tj (eng-runtime): confirmed: two distinct root causes: customer VPC/external IP quota preventing node NAT/egress setup, and registry pull throttling causing long boot delays. Both make autoscale appear to "fail" even though replicas requested.
alex (sre-support): customer reports timeouts on inference calls and elevated 5xx rates. Need to notify customer-facing team.
ryan (oncall): mitigation options: 1) failover traffic to hosted route (reduce latency but raises cost + data path change), 2) throttle new job intake for this tenant, 3) try Provision with different node image/registry mirror to avoid pull throttling. Which is fastest?
maya.nguyen: fastest short-term: enable fallback routing for customer to hosted inference endpoint (read-only model) and throttle their queue at the gateway. I'll open a route.
tj (eng-runtime): I can flip a per-tenant routing policy. Command: `redwood route set --tenant acme --fallback hosted-us-east --mode redirect --max-qps 50`
ryan (oncall): do it. Also add a token limit to prevent huge batches.
maya.nguyen: doing both now. Also sending a mitigation note to customer slack channel.
opsbot: Action log: route-change submitted by maya.nguyen at 2040123480.
ryan (oncall): while that runs, let's try node provisioning workarounds: attempt new provisioning with image cached in private registry mirror. tj, can you spawn a provisioning job using `--use-mirror`?
tj (eng-runtime): spawning: `provision-node --cluster acme-vpc-1 --gpu type=A100 --image rwd-private-mirror/redwood-gpu:cached --use-mirror true`
```
provision: request_id=pr-5589 status=pending
```
If mirror works, boot time should be ~90s instead of 6m.
maya.nguyen: customer notified: "we're routing your requests to a hosted fallback and limiting intake to reduce failures. engineering working on provisioning." Customer responded: "ack, prefer hosted fallback until you stabilize"
alex (sre-support): tracking impact: affected tenant requests failing = ~3% of overall platform 5xx spike. We'll keep postmortem scoped to private autoscale path.
ryan (oncall): update: fallback routing in effect, throughput capped. Observed queued pending drop from 1380 -> 420 in ~4m. Good trending.
opsbot: Metrics snapshot: pending=420, avg-latency=38s, 5xx-rate trending down.
tj (eng-runtime): new nodes creation succeeded with mirror image. 2 nodes joined, GPU allocatable visible.
```
kubectl get nodes -l cluster=acme-vpc-1
NAME            STATUS   ROLES    AGE
acme-node-12    Ready    gpu      00:02
acme-node-13    Ready    gpu      00:01
```
maya.nguyen: pulling in infra to request quota increase with customer cloud admin — but that may take hours. We'll keep hosted fallback until quota confirmed.
ryan (oncall): action list — assign owners:
- maya: keep fallback & rate limit until we see stable tail latency (owner)
- tj: validate mirror-based provisioning and bake permanent mirror option for private clusters (owner)
- alex: customer comms + runbook update (owner)
- ryan: postmortem & severity review (owner)
ryan (oncall): escalating to eng-runtime manager for follow-up tomorrow if quota request not approved.
maya.nguyen: adding temporary alert to detect image pullbackoff spikes and IP quota rejections across private clusters.
tj (eng-runtime): I'll add an autoscaler health check that surfaces "provision_attempts failing with cloud API error" in console.
alex (sre-support): customer ops asked for ETA — told them 2-3 hours with fallback, but permanent fix depends on cloud quota. They accepted.
opsbot: Incident INC-204012 status: mitigated -> partial (fallback active). Next updates by 2040124000.
ryan (oncall): thanks team. We'll keep this thread for updates and postmortem notes. If any regression or rollback needed, call pager immediately.
maya.nguyen: adding quick note for postmortem: root causes = (1) customer cloud resource quota prevented node egress setup, (2) registry pull throttling increased provisioning latency, (3) autoscaler lacks explicit handling for quota-denied provisioning (treats it as transient).
tj (eng-runtime): doc pointer: I'll draft recommended config: `--use-mirror`, `--prewarm-nodes`, and explicit autoscaler error classification.
ryan (oncall): closing immediate pager. Leaving thread open for follow-up. :thumbsup:
